watches.name: Timepod
watches.description: We went all-out to make this a watch you would never get bored with. Lug-release system With a press of a button, you can release the lugs and pull them straight from the case – no special tools required, yet exceptionally secure. Complex. Worry-free The lug-release system is designed to inhibit dirt from entering the mechanism, while remaining easy to open for user maintenance if ever needed – without risking damage to other parts of the watch. Proprietary sapphire crystal The unique sapphire crystal gives the watch a bright front and sleek profile. It encloses the dial and hands, and is firmly attached to the case with 6 individual screws. Clear from all sides, bevelled, and AR-coated inside. A truly one-of-a-kind design. Dual time-zones The Timepod features true GMT functionality, with an independently adjustable hour hand and a 24-hour hand for tracking a second time zone. Illuminated A fully illuminated date wheel, integrated with the symmetry of the dial. Mechanical imagination – housed within a 11.2 mm scratch-resistant pod. The case itself measures just 6.4 mm. In-house made, by hand Starting from a block of metal, Timepod is crafted in our own workshop, including milling, lathing, bead blasting, hardening, engraving, regulating, assembly, and testing – one watch at a time. .half-txt.half-txt-100{ width: 100%; } .full-width-text-message .h-timepod-boxes, .h-timepod-boxes{ font: 400 normal 1.8rem / 2rem “Roboto Condensed”, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .full-width-text-message .p-timepod-boxes, .p-timepod-boxes{ font: 200 normal 1.3rem / 1.7rem “Roboto Condensed”, sans-serif; } .show-only-on-mobile{ display: none; } .outside_header h2{ margin-top: 3rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; } .drop-down-content ol.one-step{ list-style:circle; } @media screen and (max-width: 840px){ .mobile-top-margin-small{ margin-top: 1.5rem; } .hide-on-mobile{ display: none; } .show-only-on-mobile{ display: block; } .outside_header h2 { margin: 0 !important; padding-top: 3rem; padding-bottom: 1rem; background: #123; color: #fff; font: 200 normal 2rem/2rem ‘Roboto Condensed’,sans-serif !important; text-transform: uppercase; } .outside_header .pic_n_text{ flex-direction: column-reverse; } .outside_header .pic_n_text .specs{ margin-top: 0; } .outside_header .pic_n_text .spec-text{ padding-top: 1.5rem; } } Technical Specifications Length x width x lug-to-lug 39 x 39 x 46.6 mm Thickness (including sapphire) 11.2 mm Lug width x lug bar diameter max 22 mm x 1.8 mm Crystal Proprietary sapphire, screwed onto case Crown Screw-down Movement Automatic, dual timezones, luminous date, regulated (-1/+6 s/day at time of shipment), Miyota 9075 based Water resistance 70 m (swimmable) Dial Engraved, Sandwich, E.C Brite Hands Gold & silver plated, E.C Brite Strap Rubber, sailcloth pattern, deployant clasp, tucked end Extra Proprietary lug-release system, scratch-resistant case. watches.name: Calypso II
watches.description: Design As always with E.C.A sports watches, our DNA comes to life in the use of clear cut lines, solid construction and the mixture of polished and sandblasted finishes. Not to mention the innovative placement of a Power Reserve indicator, which we find ever so useful. A mixture of high-polished and luminescent markers ensures easy readability in all light conditions. The photo models wrist size is: 6.5” / 16.5 cm. Integrated look The signature lug design from E.C.A leaves a minimal gap in-between strap and watch-head to make for an integrated look. It features a width of 18mm to fit your personal preference of straps. The lugs of our sports watches have been called ”among the most comfortable out there” and we tend to agree. Precise automatic movement Reliable M9000-series based movement. Regulated in-house for precise accuracy. Power Reserve Indicator displayed on the dial between 9’ & 10’, Date Calendar at 3’. Equipped with Parashock system for lasting durability. Specifications Diameter x Thickness (mm) 39 x 12 Power Reserve Indicator. 45h+ running time Lug Width x Lug-to-Lug (mm) 18 x 48 Dial Textured, deep blue Water Resistance 120 meters Hands & Markers Glowing Ice-Blue Crystal Sapphire, AR-Coating inside Movement Automatic, Regulated in-house Calendar Date Window at 3’ Bracelet Stainless Steel w/ Butterfly Clasp The Calypso II on a Steel Bracelet is limited to a small series. watches.name: Cpt
watches.description: Inspired by the old sea dog, the CPT is an unexpected tool watch – built to maintain a somewhat glamorous appearance through a stormy existence. Compact in size. Packing a punch 35.6 mm wide and just 8.5 mm thick under the boxed sapphire, the Cpt delivers 100 m water resistance, a triple-sealed screw-down crown, and a full 30.3 mm dial with luminous markers. Rough meets refined A hallmark of E.C.Andersson’s design. Relentless Precision Each watch is carefully regulated in-house to achieve and accuracy within -1/+6 seconds per day, in accordance with our Precision Certification standards. watches.name: Calypso II
watches.description: Design As always with E.C.A sports watches, our DNA comes to life in the use of clear cut lines, solid construction and the mixture of polished and sandblasted finishes. Not to mention the innovative placement of a Power Reserve indicator, which we find ever so useful. A mixture of high-polished and luminescent markers ensures easy readability in all light conditions. The photo models wrist size is: 6.5” / 16.5 cm. Integrated look The signature lug design from E.C.A leaves a minimal gap in-between strap and watch-head to make for an integrated look. It features a width of 18mm to fit your personal preference of straps. The lugs of our sports watches have been called ”among the most comfortable out there” and we tend to agree. Precise automatic movement Reliable M9000-series based movement. Regulated in-house for precise accuracy. Power Reserve Indicator displayed on the dial between 9’ & 10’, Date Calendar at 3’. Equipped with Parashock system for lasting durability. Specifications Diameter x Thickness (mm) 39 x 12 Power Reserve Indicator. 45h+ running time Lug Width x Lug-to-Lug (mm) 18 x 48 Dial Textured, deep blue Water Resistance 120 meters Hands & Markers Glowing Ice-Blue Crystal Sapphire, AR-Coating inside Movement Automatic, Regulated in-house Calendar Date Window at 3’ Bracelet Stainless Steel w/ Butterfly Clasp The Calypso II on a Steel Bracelet is limited to a small series.
